effectBoundary: surface-only; the entire visible page including all typography is produced by the single canvas

hypotheses.statement: One WebGPU canvas renders every page section, composited through a shared post-processing node graph.
The CRT look is achieved with DOM/CSS overlays on top of a plain 3D render.
Page typography is DOM text positioned over the canvas.

interactions.response: Lenis 1.3.3 smooths an overflow container whose spacer is 14259px = 17.8 viewport heights for 4 sections
central GN({pageType,type:'drag',listeners}) registry routes canvas pointer events per page and sets document.body.style.cursor
GN({type:'button'}) drives motion values animated at duration 0.15

importantUnknowns: Live in-browser render of the hero could not be captured: the asset preloader stalls behind blocked video autoplay in the in-app browser. Post-chain behaviour was instead confirmed against the boot screen, which renders through the same composite.

evidence.fact: exactly one canvas exists; backing store 1920x1200 for a 1280x800 CSS box, i.e. pixel ratio clamped to 1.5 while the display reports dpr 2
the canvas carries data-engine="three.js r183 webgpu"; window.__THREE__ is "183"; navigator.gpu is present and getContext('webgpu') succeeds

a single TSL node graph composites every page: selective mip-map bloom, warm phosphor add, temporal persistence, sepia, brightness/contrast, lens distortion, rounded-bezel mask, UI-aware chromatic aberration, luminance-inverse Gaussian grain
the app loads stix_regular/medium/bold as .json + .png pairs, i.e. bitmap/MSDF font atlases sampled inside the canvas rather than DOM webfonts
pages are registered as portal scenes via Tl({pageType,type,fov,near,far,basePosition,baseRotation}); observed pageTypes are office, projects, project, about-us, contact, fwa
5.2 MB preloaded before entry: 6 GLB props, rgba_noise, bank_* PBR textures, Mux stills at w800-h600, and prebaked AVIF sprite sheets for video
